subject.title: Control UI: rethink sessions sidebar (agent sections, smart groups, draft sessions with worktree/node target bar)

question: Should OpenClaw adopt the linked sessions/sidebar/worktree redesign, including gateway-owned custom groups and the unified draft-session target bar?
rationale: The source-supported usability gaps are real, but the solution adds broad permanent product, protocol, persistence, permissions, and navigation surface under a protected maintainer label.

options.title: Review the full stack
options.body: Evaluate the gateway foundation, sidebar redesign, and worktrees upgrade together and require complete fresh-install, upgrade, and end-to-end proof before landing.

options.title: Narrow the redesign
options.body: Accept human-readable naming and worktree visibility improvements while deferring server-owned groups and the unified creation workflow.

options.title: Keep the current model
options.body: Decline the broad redesign and extract only independently approved usability fixes into smaller work.

recommendation.title: Review the full stack
recommendation.body: Evaluate the gateway foundation, sidebar redesign, and worktrees upgrade together and require complete fresh-install, upgrade, and end-to-end proof before landing.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored the product proposal, all three implementation branches, and recent adjacent sidebar work.
